serviceDescriptions.aliyun:
Alibaba Cloud Tongyi Qianwen big model service has excellent performance in Chinese understanding and generation. 
Provide enterprise-level AI solutions and customized services.
serviceDescriptions.anthropic:
Focusing on safe and beneficial AI systems, the Claude model excels in reasoning, writing and code generation. 
Pay attention to AI security and controllability.
serviceDescriptions.azure:
Microsoft Cloud Platform provides OpenAI services, enterprise-level security and compliance. 
Suitable for enterprise users, providing privatized deployment options.
serviceDescriptions.deepseek:
AI models focusing on code generation and programming tasks, perform excellently in code understanding, generation and debugging. 
Supports multiple programming languages.
serviceDescriptions.google:
Google's latest multimodal AI model supports multiple inputs such as text, images, and audio. 
Outstanding performance in understanding and generating multimodal content.
serviceDescriptions.lmstudio:
Local AI model management tool provides a graphical interface to run various open source models. 
Supports model download, management and local reasoning.
serviceDescriptions.mistral:
Europe's leading AI company, providing efficient open source and business models. 
Outstanding performance in terms of speed of reasoning and cost-effectiveness.
serviceDescriptions.ollama:
The local AI model running framework supports running various open source models on personal devices. 
Protect privacy without internet connection, suitable for offline use.
serviceDescriptions.openai:
The world's leading AI research company provides advanced models. 
Supports streaming output, fast response speed, suitable for various AI application scenarios.
serviceDescriptions.openrouter:
AI model aggregation platform, providing a unified access interface for a variety of mainstream AI models. 
Supports model comparison and cost optimization, suitable for multi-model application scenarios.
serviceDescriptions.siliconflow:
The leading AI computing platform in China provides high-performance GPU resources and a variety of AI models. 
Suitable for large-scale AI training and reasoning tasks.
serviceDescriptions.tencent:
AI services provided by Tencent Cloud include Hunyuan big model. 
Integrate Tencent ecosystem, suitable for domestic corporate users and provide localized services.
serviceDescriptions.zhipu:
An AI company with a background in Tsinghua University, providing GLM series large models. 
There are unique advantages in Chinese understanding and academic research.
